note: Every upstream input is pinned by SHA256. A build is only reproducible when these hashes match. Update deliberately, never automatically.

unimorph-ell.name: UniMorph Modern Greek (ell)
unimorph-ell.comment: lemma \t form \t features. Features are aspect-first (IPFV/PFV/PRF), person, number, case, gender.

unimorph-grc.name: UniMorph Ancient Greek (grc)
unimorph-grc.comment: Nouns and adjectives only. This dataset contains NO Ancient Greek verbs.

unimorph-eng.name: UniMorph English (eng)
unimorph-eng.comment: English morphology. Used by the English lane (Phase 4).

kaikki-greek.name: kaikki.org Greek dictionary (Wiktextract)
kaikki-greek.comment: ~221 MB. Senses, translations, examples. Assert whether this file also contains grc entries before relying on it.

elwiktionary-dump.name: Greek Wiktionary pages-articles dump
elwiktionary-dump.comment: ~111 MB compressed. Source of el-κλίσ-* verb stem tuples, el-κλίση-* declension classes, ΔΦΑ pronunciation and συλλ syllabification.
